sources.entry: unslop - CLI that strips AI writing patterns (sycophantic openers, filler phrases, em-dash overuse) from text files and stdin. Pass through code blocks and URLs unchanged. npm install -g unslop.

summary.one_liner: unslop is a CLI, editor-rule, and Claude Code plugin that strips common AI writing patterns (sycophantic openers, stock vocabulary, filler phrases, em-dash pileups) from text while leaving code, URLs, and structure intact.
summary.what_it_does: It rewrites AI-generated prose to sound less like a language model, using a deterministic regex pass (no network) or an optional LLM pass. Deterministic mode protects fenced and inline code, URLs, headings, YAML frontmatter, tables, and blockquotes, and fails the run if the validator detects changes to them. It offers five modes (subtle, balanced, full, voice-match, anti-detector) and can be activated inside Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI, and OpenAI Codex through rule files or hooks. Optional features include a voice-match profile made of numeric style metrics, a reasoning-trace stripper for agent output, a surprisal-variance reading using a local distilgpt2 model, and a detector feedback loop that reports scores from an external detector model. The README says its detector-score reduction is small (0.0–0.2 percentage points on its own fixtures), so it is positioned as a polish tool rather than a detector bypass.
use_cases: clean up AI-drafted cover letters or resumes before sending
remove sycophantic openers and filler from chatbot replies
polish blog posts or LinkedIn posts written with an LLM
strip reasoning wrappers from agent output before shipping
rewrite markdown files while keeping code and links unchanged
apply a personal writing style profile to AI drafts
how_to_run: pipx install 'unslop[llm]'  # optional LLM mode SDK
/plugin marketplace add MohamedAbdallah-14/unslop  # in Claude Code
notable: Deterministic mode is pure regex with no network calls and byte-preserves code, URLs, and headings, failing the run on drift
Voice-match stores only numeric style metrics (no prose) in a 0600-mode JSON file
One source of truth for skills, mirrored to Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini, and Codex via CI sync
Reports a blind LLM-judge preference result (21/21) and openly says it does not defeat AI detectors
Opt-in reasoning-trace sanitizer writes stripped content to a sidecar file
caveats: README states detector-score resistance is minimal; it is not a GPTZero or Turnitin bypass
LLM mode cannot byte-enforce preservation; deterministic mode is needed for a hard guarantee
Surprisal and detector features need large model downloads (about 330 MB for distilgpt2) and optional extras
README says not to use it for legal, medical, or runbook text where precision matters
keywords: share polished text with my team
